steps.title: robotwin2 arm pose · robotwin2 ee action
steps.code:
# Shoe is visually centered on the blue mat and its registry pose matches the mat center.
# Arm move-planner is failing; try a raw ee take_action to open the gripper and release.
cur = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag='left')
rp = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag='right')
lp_pose = cur.output['pose_world']
rp_pose = rp.output['pose_world']
act = list(lp_pose) + [1.0] + list(rp_pose) + [1.0]
sub = primitives.call(name='submit_robotwin2_ee_action', action=act, action_type='ee',
                      evidence_handles=['robotwin2:visual:23'])
print('raw ee ok', sub.ok)
print(str(sub.output)[:400])
